data.body: Phase 1: claimed grindable-deviant-angwantibo in fresh origin/main worktree b0aac2314b. Direct inner-process monitor completed 80/80 clean exits (1.50-1.83s); an earlier 970.76s measurement was rejected as RTK-wrapper-confounded. Deterministic fault injection blocks only the second repo-root git status probe: inner outage test reaches .[100%], then SIGUSR1 shows the main thread in tests/_isolation.py:59 subprocess.run called from tests/conftest.py:681 pytest_sessionfinish. This exactly reproduces the reported pre-summary TimeoutExpired boundary; independent hypothesis investigator is still assessing rivals before RCA.
